title: System-wide text chat
description: Simple system-scoped text chat: every player in a shard sees every message, with rate limiting and sanitization. No private messages, channels, or history in v1.
acceptanceCriteria: WS 'chat' {text} from an authenticated in-system connection → server validates (non-empty, <= 200 chars after trim) and broadcasts chat {from, text, ts} to the whole shard (including sender echo)
Rate limit: > 5 messages / 10 s from one connection → message dropped, {code:'rate-limited'} sent to that sender only (TASK-65 limiter reused)
Sanitization: server strips control characters and non-text; client renders text-only (React auto-escaping, no innerHTML) — XSS test: message '' renders as inert text
Chat log UI: last 100 messages, system-scoped (cleared on system change), scrollable, minimal styling (top-left column, above player list); message format '[12:03] CALLSIGN: text'

WS integration test: 2 clients, 3 messages each, all delivered in order (monotonic ts), rate-limited 6th within window dropped, invalid messages (empty, > 200 chars, non-string) rejected with 'invalid-message'

steps.details: shard.handleChat(conn, msg): validate with shared zod schema (TASK-9); rate limiter (TASK-65) keyed by connId; broadcast. No persistence (v1).
ChatLog component: ring buffer of 100; input only visible when focused (Enter toggles, keeps gameplay flow); messages auto-escaped by React; new-message scroll pinned only if user is at bottom.
All WS integration cases incl. the XSS payload assertion (query DOM for absence of img element). Run full suite + typecheck.

technicalNotes: Chat is deliberately minimal; private chat and persistence are post-v1.
ts is server-assigned (ms epoch) so cross-client ordering is consistent.
